subject: RE: Renewal & expansion discussion — Acme Corp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@acme.com>, Tom Garcia <tom.garcia@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal & expansion discussion — Acme Corp

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap from my side and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Summary of what we heard
- Primary goals: reduce inference cost for high-volume chat use-cases, improve 95th-percentile latency for peak hours, and enable private deployment for regulated PII workflows.
- Current usage: ~1.2B tokens / month across dev and prod; 70% generative chat, 20% embeddings for semantic search, 10% misc.
- Pain points:
  - Spiky traffic during support peak windows causing latency SLA misses (~800ms p95).
  - Rising costs with current autop-scaling configuration.
  - Need for VPC/managed private control plane for EU-sourced data.

Proposed upsell / renewal path (high level)
1) Renewal: align on 12-month committed capacity to lock in unit pricing for tokens (target start: 2026-08-01).
2) Expansion: add a Dedicated pool for production chat workload (2x current prod capacity estimate) + optional Private deployment for EU regulatory scope.
3) Immediate optimizations: enable prefix/KV caching and tweak batching thresholds — expected 20–30% cost reduction and improved p95 latency.

Deliverables I’ll share (attached):
- ACME_Q2_usage_report.csv — current token/route breakdown.
- Redwood_proposed_amendment_v1.pdf — draft amendment showing committed units and pricing bands.

Open questions / asks from your side
- Confirm target renewal start date (you mentioned early August).
- Which EU region(s) require private deployment?
- Any internal procurement deadlines for PO or SOW sign-off?

Next steps
- I’ll send a draft SOW and a Dedicated capacity SOW for your technical team to review by end of day tomorrow. (attached: Redwood_SOW_dedicated_capacity_v2.pdf)
- Proposed follow-up: technical deep-dive with Rishi + your infra team on Monday 7/06 at 11am PT. Please let me know if that works or we can find another slot.

Thanks — appreciate the time.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124

Attachments: ACME_Q2_usage_report.csv (csv), Redwood_proposed_amendment_v1.pdf (pdf), Redwood_SOW_dedicated_capacity_v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@acme.com>

Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & expansion discussion — Acme Corp

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful and matches our notes. A few clarifying items from my side: 

1) Timeline: yes, we’re targeting an August 1 start for the renewed contract. Procurement has a deadline of 2026-07-20 for purchase order submission if we want spend reflected in Q3.

2) EU requirements: we need a private deployment for EU-sourced data (Germany preferred; team will confirm specific regions). Can your Private offering support a DE region deployment with KMS integration?

3) Capacity ask: our forecast shows a need for ~2x current prod throughput for the next 6 months. Can you provide pricing for the Dedicated pool option + 2x committed tokens for the renewal amendment?

4) Security/compliance: can you attach the SOC 2 snapshot and the data retention policy for our security review?

If you can get the updated SOW and the amendment with the pricing bands over, we’ll circulate to procurement and schedule the technical deep dive — Tom will join the infra call.

Thanks —
Samantha
Director, AI Platforms | Acme Corporation
samantha.lowe@acme.com | +1 212-555-0199
